comment.text: ESR1 D538 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v2. Source observations include Breast tumors; Ovarian tumors; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: ovaryfallopiantube; Unspecified tumor site; Uterine tumors. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position.
